game.title: BLINDSPOT
game.description: Enter the VOID in this nightmare fueled arcade vision. Locked in an eternal chase, avoid eye contact at any cost by sliding, hopping and hyper-dashing your way around the SPHERE. Careful navigation is key because in this nightmare, looks can kill.

features.feature: Completed in one month and exhibited as a part of Lockwood Immersive's FLUX - A Toronto Based Immersive Cyberpunk Experience.
